item.title: Senate Approves Schwartz as CDC Director
item.description: The Senate confirmed Erica Schwartz as CDC director on Wednesday, giving the agency its first full-time political leader in a period of transition.

item.title: Employers hire less but increase pay
item.description: Private employment data indicates the labor market may be tighter than headline hiring numbers suggest, with worker pay accelerating.

item.title: Socialist McKinney defeats Thanedar in Democratic primary
item.description: State Rep. Donavan McKinney defeated two-term incumbent Rep. Shri Thanedar in Tuesday's Democratic primary for Michigan's 13th Congressional District.

item.title: DOJ's voter roll efforts face judicial setbacks
item.description: Federal judges, appointed by both parties, have repeatedly ruled against the Justice Department in its attempts to alter voter rolls.
